intro: My experience combines independent research, academic program support, and leadership in student economics organizations.

experience.organization: Vietnam Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics (VIASM)
experience.description: Coordinated participant information, academic correspondence, research records, and materials for international programs. Also organized VIASM activity data from 2012–2025 for exploratory work on academic activity, public research spending, and scientific output.
Develop research ideas, support academic activities, and help turn broad topics into workable research questions.
Support economic analysis, collaborative learning, and research activities in international and development economics.

leadership.description: Coordinate academic planning, internal operations, and student research activities in international economics.

closing: Together, these experiences have strengthened three parts of my research practice: asking better economic questions, working responsibly with collaborators, and communicating evidence clearly. They are not substitutes for empirical research, but they form the collaborative foundation behind the projects documented in this portfolio.
